description: Implementation of ApiContentRepository class that interacts with a remote API service to fetch content items and TV channels, using Retrofit and Kotlin coroutines.

classes.name: ApiContentRepository
classes.description: Provides API-based implementation for fetching content and TV channel data, handling API responses, errors, and mapping data models.

methods.name: getContinueWatching
methods.description: Fetches the list of content items the user is currently watching, returning a Result wrapping the list or an error.

methods.name: getTvChannels
methods.description: Fetches the list of TV channels from remote API, returning a Result wrapping the list or an error.
